applicationFee.note: International initial application $60; domestic $35. Previously applied but did not enroll: choose Additional Application to avoid paying again; readmission options also avoid another fee. Confirm category eligibility; no general hardship waiver verified.

english.note: IELTS Academic. Central country/degree exemption list applies; program may set higher requirements.

documents: Transcripts (unofficial for review; official after admission)
Statement of interest, about500 words, on research interests/experience and academic/career objectives
Faculty sponsor letter describing willingness to mentor and proposed funding
NACES course-by-course evaluation when highest degree is from a foreign institution (2020 department handbook)
requirements.note: Current central doctoral GPA minimum3.0; bachelor’s or master’s entry. Department requires prospective mentor identification. GRE, two-letter count and statement/evaluation specifications are from the opened2020 handbook because current catalog is blocked; confirm current department instructions.

funding.note: Teaching assistantships are competitive and depend on available positions. Applications may be accepted without an assistantship. Earlier handbook states teaching assistants typically receive a tuition waiver; no current stipend amount or all-student guarantee established.
